description:
The Clean Architecture Solution Template popularized by Steve @ardalis Smith. Provides a great starting point for modern and/or DDD solutions built with .NET 11.
      Features zero tight coupling to database or data access technology.
releaseNotes:
* Upgrade to .NET 11 and the latest stable NuGet packages, including FastEndpoints 9 and xUnit v3.
      * Rename the Contributor Get use case to GetById (GetContributorByIdQuery/Handler) to match the GetById endpoint.
      * Fix ContributorId validation rejecting EF Core temporary keys on insert.
      * Fix the UseDbGeneratedIds migration failing on SQL Server.
      * Functional tests fall back to SQLite when Docker can't run Linux containers.
      * Use Shouldly for all test assertions.
      * Fix file renames for project names that aren't valid namespaces.
      * The package no longer includes a copy of MinimalClean: new solutions no longer get a stray MinimalClean folder, and installing it no longer registers min-clean.
      * New solutions now include a .gitignore (previously left out of the package, so bin/ and obj/ were committed after git init).
      * New solutions no longer include repository-only files (CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, icon.png, .claude settings, and two outdated testing notes). Testing guidance now lives at https://cleanarchitecture.ardalis.com/testing/
      * See the v11 to v12 migration guide: https://cleanarchitecture.ardalis.com/migration-guides/v11-to-v12/
title: ASP.NET Core Clean Architecture Solution
